Parameters

Matched bool

Whether the capture was accepted as the person: similarity at or above the configured minimum and, when liveness is enforced, a liveness the application accepts.

Similarity double

How alike the two faces are (0.0 = different, 1.0 = identical). Zero when no comparison happened.

Liveness string

What the provider reported about the capture being of a live person, in its own words, or null when it reported nothing.

Failure FaceVerificationFailureType

Why the capture was not accepted, or None.
